newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet nosedives with gas oil as buyers stay away.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet nosedives with gas oil as buyers stay away.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices extended Friday's $3-4 losses by a further $3-4 a tonne on Monday as benchmark IPE gas oil futures continued to slide.

Traders said thin prompt demand also saw differentials to the weaker gas oil futures under some pressure with the $7 backwardation on IPE gas oil leaving buyers now looking at March futures related numbers.
Barges were valued around $222 a tonne fob ARA while cargoes were notionally pegged around $230 cif NWE.
Traders said business in NWE was slow but possible arbitrage opportunities to the Far East were the focus of a stable Mediterranean market.
However, traders said the high cost of shipping and the difficulty in securing suitable tonnage limited arbitrage trading options.
